notes.title: Major update for the video game More than Words now available!
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43694048/6f17c615ddb4d8464845c86fe35845ddeeb3d8ea.pngMajor update for the video game More than Words now available:


 Gemma 3: Conversations are now more natural with this new language model.
 Response Speed: The bot's response speed has been increased.
 Unreal Engine 5: Lighting is now more realistic based on Lumen technology.
 Graphics Options: Graphics options to configure resolution and render quality.
 Environment: The environment has been completely redefined.
 Character Model: The character has been re-modeled.
 Animations: New idle and head movement animations.
 AI Navigation System: An artificial intelligence system that allows the character to navigate the environment.

notes.title: Update to LLAMA 3.1 and support for multiple languages
notes.notes:
The game now includes the power of LLAMA 3.1 for text generation. This change mainly involves the following:

1. Responses of much higher quality and length than previous versions (LLAMA 2 and GPT NEO).

2. Support for the languages: English, Spanish, German, French, Portuguese and Italian.
